critic_risk_flags: Although H maps directly to the hospitalization-rate target, an explicit H compartment is specifically noted as weakly identifiable in short single-season series; risk of timing/magnitude confounding (H absorbing reporting/ascertainment) is high relative to delayed_I options.

Observation map I+H is poorly aligned to a hospitalization-rate target and increases confounding/identifiability risk (two latent contributors to one observed series). In a short series, it can blur timing and scale, making attribution between I vs H unstable without clear additional signals.
